title: Strict tower assembly from finite-level data
statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarComparisonAssembly
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o)
    (d : ScalarComparisonLevelData l E j o tc sc) :
    Nonempty (ScalarComparison l E j o sc tc)

source.place: Tags 0E8I and 0941; assembly over the quotient index.

proof.text: For each complex Q, use NatTrans.ofOpSequence on the homomorphisms of d.level n Q. Rewrite the two successor maps by Functor.ofOpSequence_map_homOfLE_succ and use HomologicalComplex.hom_ext with d.transition n Q i. This constructs a natural transformation of the actual strict towers.

Every component of this tower transformation is the homomorphism of d.level n Q, hence is invertible. NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app makes the tower transformation invertible. Assemble these tower isomorphisms over Q with NatIso.ofComponents. For naturality in a complex map a, apply tower and complex extensionality and rewrite d.components. Naturality of tc.ordinary n at a.f i, followed by naturality of sc.finite n at scalarReductionExtension.map (a.f i), proves the equation by functoriality and associativity.

The assembled natural isomorphism has component (d.level n Q).hom in every degree. Its ScalarComponents field is therefore precisely d.components n Q i. Package this isomorphism and component formula in ScalarComparison and Nonempty.
